summary: Log queue settings: LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_MAX_DISK_USAGE_GB (default 1 GB, queue.maxDiskSpace), LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_QUEUE_SIZE (spills to disk at 75%, discards NOTICE, INFO and DEBUG at 90%) and LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH (default /var/lib/awx), so logs are kept while for example Splunk is offline.
questions: What happens to logs when Splunk is down?
How do I increase the log queue disk size?
Where does controller store queued logs during an outage?
Why are INFO logs being dropped?

answer_card.title: Buffer logs while the aggregator is down
answer_card.answer_md:
| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_MAX_DISK_USAGE_GB` | 1 | disk used to queue logs |
| `LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_QUEUE_SIZE` | n/a | messages in memory; disk at 75%, drops NOTICE/INFO/DEBUG at 90% |
| `LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH` | `/var/lib/awx` | spool directory |

Set them through `/api/v2/settings/logging/`.
